prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In after Adoption Selection: Move account sign-in to take place after pet selection so users build connection and motivation before creating an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Pick Friend Screen as Interactive Grid with Preview: Rebuild the pick_friend screen into an interactive grid layout featuring pet choice cards and live previews.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your New Desktop Companion", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Pet", "style": "playful"}, {"role": "pet_choices", "type": "preview", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Controls Tutorial Screen: Insert a dedicated onboarding screen showing how to drag, right-click, hide, and interact with the desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_controls_guide", "home_intro"], "home_intro": {"headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet is live! Check out the quick control guide to interact with your pet anytime."}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Style Selector Flow: Add a dedicated pet style selection screen right after uploading pet photos to ensure better customization results.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_style_selector", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload a clear, front-facing photo of your pet for best results."}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Sign-In Persistence Hint: Add explicit hint text on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in restores existing pets and prevents account duplication.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your main account to keep your existing pets and progress safe."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Live Generation Progress & Tip Carousel on Waiting Screen: Display progress indicators and helpful tips while waiting for the pet setup to complete.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 8, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "calm", "text": "Fun pet care facts while your companion prepares"}]}}
6: [choose_path, layout] Centered Mascot Intro on Story Screen: Change the initial story screen layout to centered with an animated mascot greeting the user.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "asset": "asset:welcome_mascot"}]}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Free Accessories Badge on Adoption Certificate: Add a starter rewards badge on the adoption certificate screen to encourage users to finish pet adoption.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Complete setup now to unlock free starter pet hats and items!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Free Starter Accessories Included", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [home, notification] Ready Notification Toggle during Waiting Step: Add an option to notify users when pet generation is finished so they don't abandon the app while waiting.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"}}
9: [finish, copy] Clear Desktop Spawning Instructions on Home Intro: Update the home intro text to clearly explain that the pet will appear directly floating on the desktop screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet Is Now On Your Desktop!", "body": "Look around your screen! You can click and drag your pet anywhere on your desktop."}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in within onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.
Redesigning the pick_friend screen with live previews preserves its core function.
Adding a tutorial screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding a style selector sub-flow inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding an informative hint to sign-in is allowed.
Adding progress indicators and tip carousels to the waiting screen is allowed.
Redesigning the story screen layout is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions free accessories, which violates Rule 3.
Adding a ready notification option during the waiting step is allowed.
Updating text in the home intro screen is allowed.
